novelty: Candidate statistic constructed for this study; relation to CPI and model-X discussed; no priority claim
native_rule: single-draw knockoff+ q=0.20, q=0.10 sensitivity on same W; no forced filling of native sets
contexts: 4 independent row/coordinate-wise Bernoulli masks and antithetic complements selecting coordinatewise min/max of each pair
studentization: mean per-seller loss contrast / (SD per-seller contrast / sqrt(number of sellers) + 1e-8); not a t-test
score_sample_independence: prediction models and preprocessing fixed using training plus early-stopping period, never scoring responses
theory_boundary: knockoff+ conditional guarantee only for exact knockoffs on an independent inference sample; no guarantee for fitted copula on Olist or deliberately misspecified t scenario
naive_control: raw-context replacement; deliberately not assumed full sign-flip, nominal threshold results are stress diagnostics not valid FDR claims

predictors.xgboost: unchanged V7 selected config, refit on all model-training rows
predictors.tabm: official tabm==0.0.3, V7 config, <=100 epochs, patience 12; determine epoch on internal validation and refit with fixed epoch
predictors.deep_lasso: V7 selected config, internal validation then refit; score original loss gradients on inference rows
predictors.lasso: ElasticNet alpha=.01 l1_ratio=.999 on augmented inference pairs only; symmetric pooled centering/scaling; its smaller fitting-label budget is disclosed
predictors.matched_linear_predictor: ElasticNet alpha=.01 l1_ratio=.999 trained on the same 1200 model-training rows as XGBoost/TabM; identical studentized orbit scorer

real_data.inference: rank split (2018-03..04), not used to train or early-stop base predictor
real_data.test: test split (2018-05..07), previously observed, descriptive only
real_data.sampling: V7 shared manifest: 30 complementary half pairs +20 70% +20 80%, plus10 algorithm-seed-only, 1 full reference
real_data.generator: training-only deterministic empirical CDF, Ledoit-Wolf Gaussian latent estimate, equicorrelated S, inverse training quantiles
real_data.downstream_evaluation: canonical sorted feature IDs, common XGBoost and TabM, refit on train+tune+rank; identical sets reuse predictions

simulation.downstream: common canonical-column XGBoost 140 trees depth3 lr.05 seed11 on 1600 train+inference rows
simulation.native_prediction_empty: constant mean of development y; empty selection never omitted

report.primary_claims: native mean FDP and power against matched-q linear paired baseline; fixed-budget utility against SHAP
report.simulation_uncertainty: paired Monte Carlo differences by scenario with Holm-adjusted comparisons for primary method versus comparators
report.real_uncertainty: 5000 paired seller-cluster bootstrap conditional on the observed months and fitted models
